title: Best Snow Blower 2026: 5 blowers tested through one Buffalo winter
description: EGO SNT2400, Toro Power Max 826, Ariens Deluxe 28, Ryobi 40V, Snow Joe iON100V — one Buffalo winter with 95 inches of snow. Throw distance, runtime, wet-snow capability.
lede: Five snow blowers. One Buffalo, NY winter. 95 inches including 3 storms over 16 inches. We measured throw distance, runtime, clearing speed, and how each handled wet lake-effect snow on a 200-foot driveway.
methodology: Same 200-foot asphalt driveway, same season. Each blower used as primary blower for 1-2 storms. Tracked: clearing time per inch of snow, throw distance, runtime (cordless) or fuel (gas), wet-snow capability, morning start reliability.

sections.heading: Single-stage vs two-stage
paragraphs: Single-stage (Ryobi, Snow Joe, EGO partially): single auger throws snow directly. Best for snow under 12" on flat surfaces. Doesn't self-propel.
Two-stage (Toro, Ariens): augur breaks snow + impeller throws. Self-propelled. Best for deep snow (16+") and uneven surfaces.
EGO SNT2400 is a hybrid — single-stage architecture with peak-stage assist. Strong for 12-16"; struggles past 16 vs true two-stage.

sections.heading: Throw distance and clearing
paragraphs: Snow throw on 8" dry snow: Toro 40-50 ft, Ariens 45-50 ft, EGO 35-40 ft, Ryobi 25-30 ft, Snow Joe 15-20 ft. Gas two-stage dominates.
Clearing 200-ft driveway with 8" snow: Toro 12 min, Ariens 12 min, EGO 18 min (recharge halfway), Ryobi 22 min (75% before battery), Snow Joe 28 min.
Wet lake-effect snow (16+"): Toro and Ariens handled. EGO bogged but recovered. Ryobi partially cleared then stopped. Snow Joe failed at 8+" wet.

sections.heading: Cold-weather reliability
paragraphs: Morning starts at 10°F: Toro electric start instant. Ariens electric start instant (+ pull cord). EGO push-button reliable. Ryobi push-button but range drops 20% in extreme cold. Snow Joe also reliable.
Gas (Toro, Ariens) requires fuel storage and seasonal maintenance (oil, plugs, carb cleaning). Cordless (EGO, Ryobi, Snow Joe) need no maintenance but battery range matters in long sessions.

faqs.a: Gas for heavy snow (16+" multiple times/year) or long driveways (200+ ft). Cordless for moderate regions or short driveways (under 100 ft). EGO SNT2400 is the cordless that handles the most.
Two-stage (Toro, Ariens) for deep snow and rural/wide driveways. Single-stage (Ryobi, Snow Joe) for under 12" on flat surfaces in suburbs.
Both pro-grade. Toro Power Max has slightly better trigger-operated steering. Ariens Deluxe has cast-iron gearbox (longer lifespan). Pick by local dealer service.
Two 56V 7.5Ah batteries handle a 100-150 ft driveway in 8" snow. For 200+ ft or deep snow, recharge mid-session.

ego-snow-blower-snt2400.review: EGO Power+ SNT2400 is the right cordless for moderate-snow regions. Two 56V batteries, 24" clearing path, peak-stage assist, 22-second 90° chute rotation. Quietest in test. Best if you don't want gas maintenance.

toro-power-max-826.review: Toro Power Max 826 OXE is the right pick for serious snow regions. Two-stage gas, 26" path, 252cc engine, electric start, heated handgrips. Cleared 200-ft driveway with 8" snow in 12 min. Strong dealer network.

ariens-deluxe-28.review: Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO is the right pick for heavy snow and steep driveways. Two-stage gas, 28" path, 306cc engine, cast-iron gearbox. Pick for Buffalo, Rochester, Minneapolis residents with 100+ inches/year.

ryobi-40v-21inch-snow-blower.review: Ryobi 40V 21" Snow Blower is the right pick for Ryobi 40V ecosystem owners with short driveways. 21" single-stage cordless, 13" deep, $500-700. Cleared 75% of 200-ft before battery died — best for under 100 ft.

snow-joe-ion100v.review: Snow Joe iON100V is the right pick for short driveways and light snow. 100V cordless, 18" path, 35 lb (lightest). Best for snow under 8"; failed at 8+" wet. Easy storage. Affordable entry.

offerNotes.ego-snow-blower-snt2400: Buy at egopowerplus.com or Home Depot. Often bundled with batteries + charger.
offerNotes.toro-power-max-826: Buy at Toro dealers or Home Depot. Dealer service network is the real value.
offerNotes.ariens-deluxe-28: Buy at Ariens dealers. Dealer-installed service.
offerNotes.snow-joe-ion100v: Buy at amazon.com or snowjoe.com. Battery included.

pinDescription: Best snow blower 2026: EGO vs Toro vs Ariens vs Ryobi vs Snow Joe — Buffalo winter tested, 95 inches + wet lake-effect data. #snowblower
